title: Foundations: Doom Metal - The Complete Guide
summary: What Doom Metal is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Doom Metal songs: Doom metal slows Sabbath to a crawl: massive downtuned riffs, funereal tempos, and lyrics about despair and dread. It is heavy metal as weight, not speed.

History: Black Sabbath's slower songs were the template; Candlemass (1986), Saint Vitus, and Sleep (Holy Mountain, 1992) built the genre. Sunn O))) took it to drone extremes.

How the songs work: Doom Metal favors the keys of C#, C, B, D. Common forms include Riff repeated until it becomes hypnosis; Long builds to crushing climaxes. Players should master maximum fuzz, minimum tempo first, then the riff as mantra: repetition is the point. Downtuned; capos are for other genres.
